{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check if any LOYAL completed orders exist
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of LOYAL completed orders: {mean_revenue}")

# Output the result
mean_revenue"}
